subject: Arcadia Health - MAP & Evaluation Plan: deployment mode + region decision
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia Health - MAP & Evaluation Plan: deployment mode + region decision

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for the time today. Per our sync, I've attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP_Arcadia_v1.xlsx) that lays out the evaluation milestones we discussed: PoC (functional + latency checks), pilot (canary traffic), and production acceptance (SLA, security evidence). Key asks from Arcadia to confirm so we can size the evaluation properly:

- Preferred initial deployment mode for the PoC (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Target regions for latency testing (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1)
- Any compliance baseline we should include in the PoC (PHI, specific logging retention)
- Procurement timeline and legal SLA constraints you need

We recommend a pragmatic path: PoC on hosted (fastest to stand up) + dedicated reserved pool for production throughput + private option only for PHI-bound workloads. That keeps your team moving while preserving an air-gapped option for regulated data. If you're leaning strongly toward private from day one, we can carve a parallel on-prem track in the MAP but it adds ~4–6 weeks for network/KMS work.

Can you confirm preferences by end of day Thursday so we can lock the MAP and schedule a technical kickoff? Proposed next step: 45-minute decision workshop (redwood + Arcadia infra + security) where we surface a matrix of tradeoffs and the acceptance criteria.

Attachments: MAP_Arcadia_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Priya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia Health - MAP & Evaluation Plan: deployment mode + region decision

Priya — thanks for the plan and the clear summary. A few clarifying points from our side before the workshop:

- For regulatory reasons we prefer Private for any workload that touches PHI. That said, we could consider Hosted for UI-driven analyses that operate on de-identified data if the timeline is significantly faster.
- Can you provide SOC 2 evidence and the current SLA (latency + uptime)? We need that for the procurement packet.
- Region question: patient-facing latency must be sub-150ms for US users. We need guidance on which regions you've validated for that profile.
- Procurement is on a 4-week review cadence; if legal sees complex redlines we may need extra time.

I attached our procurement questionnaire (Proc_Q_Arcadia.pdf) — can you confirm who's the best point on your side to complete the technical/security sections?

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
VP, Product Operations | Arcadia Health
maria.lopez@arcadiahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0122
Attachment: Proc_Q_Arcadia.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@arcadiahealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia Health - MAP & Evaluation Plan: deployment mode + region decision

Maria — thanks for the quick read and the procurement questionnaire. Short answers and proposed path (quoting your bullets):

> - For regulatory reasons we prefer Private for any workload that touches PHI.

Completely understood — Private (VPC / on-prem) will be our recommended landing zone for PHI. We'll include KMS/HSM integration and audit log retention in the MAP acceptance criteria. That adds network configuration and (optionally) an on-prem appliance for air-gapped sites — planning delta ~4–6 weeks.

> - Can you provide SOC 2 evidence and the current SLA (latency + uptime)?

Attached: SOC2_summary.pdf (overview) and a link to a draft SLA redlines document (Draft_SAAS_SLA_redlines.docx) with typical commercial commitments. High level: 99.95% platform uptime SLA for Dedicated + Hosted with credits; latency SLOs will be per-route and we can publish empirical p50/p95 numbers for us-east-1 and us-west-2. For the PoC we recommend measuring p50/p95 across sample traffic to validate sub-150ms for your user flows.

> - Region question: patient-facing latency must be sub-150ms for US users.

We have validated models in us-east-1 and us-west-2 that meet sub-150ms p50 for short prompt/response flows on our medium-sized instance types; p95 can approach the limit depending on prompt length and streaming mode. For guaranteed tail latency at scale, Dedicated capacity plus KV cache tuning and local region replication is the safer route.

Proposed MAP update (for the workshop):
- Week 0: Technical kickoff + access exchange
- Week 1: PoC on Hosted in us-east-1 (functional tests + latency scripts)
- Week 2–3: Pilot canary (10% traffic) on Hosted + Dedicated performance baseline
- Week 4–6: Production carve (Dedicated for throughput) and parallel Private onboarding for PHI lanes if required

Priya will send an updated MAP with those milestones and acceptance criteria. I'll own the SOC2 and SLA attachments. Happy to jump on the workshop.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, Draft_SAAS_SLA_redlines.docx

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia Health - MAP & Evaluation Plan: deployment mode + region decision

Thanks Karthik — that aligns with our internal expectations. To be explicit on our desired path so everyone has the same doc:

- PoC (Week 1): Hosted in us-east-1 running de-identified data only; objective = functional validation + p50/p95 latency measurement.
- Pilot (Week 2–3): Canary traffic (10%) on Hosted to exercise routing and fallback behavior.
- Production (Week 4–6): Dedicated reserved pool in us-west-2 for primary throughput and predictable latency; Private (VPC) onboarding in parallel only for PHI-bound pipelines.

Procurement: we'll begin review on Monday and expect to surface any redlines within our 4-week cadence. We're asking Redwood to complete sections 2–5 of the procurement questionnaire (technical + security + SLAs). Who should we expect to fill those out?

I'll mark the MAP as "provisional" until the workshop and your completed questionnaire sections are returned.

Best,
Maria
